cases.query: EVALUATE ROW("v", SUM(Sales[Quantity]))
EVALUATE ROW("v", SUM(Sales[UnitPrice]))
EVALUATE ROW("v", AVERAGE(Sales[UnitPrice]))
EVALUATE ROW("min", MIN(Sales[OrderDate]), "max", MAX(Sales[ShipDate]))
EVALUATE ROW("count", COUNT(Sales[Quantity]), "counta", COUNTA(Sales[ShipDate]), "blank", COUNTBLANK(Sales[ShipDate]), "rows", COUNTROWS(Sales))
EVALUATE ROW("dc", DISTINCTCOUNT(Sales[CustomerKey]), "dcnb", DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK(Sales[ProductKey]))
EVALUATE ROW("a", DIVIDE(1, 0), "b", DIVIDE(1, 0, -1), "c", DIVIDE(7, 2), "d", DIVIDE(BLANK(), 2), "e", DIVIDE(4, BLANK()))
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "qty", SUM(Sales[Quantity]), "rows", COUNTROWS(Sales)) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Color], "qty", SUM(Sales[Quantity])) ORDER BY Product[Color]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Customer[Country], "qty", SUM(Sales[Quantity])) ORDER BY Customer[Country]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year], "qty", SUM(Sales[Quantity])) ORDER BY 'Date'[Year]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Promotion[Promotion], "qty", SUM(Sales[Quantity])) ORDER BY Promotion[Promotion]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year], Product[Category], "qty", SUM(Sales[Quantity])) ORDER BY 'Date'[Year], Product[Category]
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), Product[Category] = "Bikes"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), Product[Category] = "Bikes", 'Date'[Year] = 2024))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), Customer[Country] IN {"France", "Germany"}))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Sales), Product[Color] = "red"))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Sales), Product[Color] = BLANK()))
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), Product[Category] = "Bikes")) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), KEEPFILTERS(Product[Category] = "Bikes"))) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALL(Product[Category]))) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], 'Date'[Year], "v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALL(Product))) ORDER BY Product[Category], 'Date'[Year]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], Product[Color], "v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ALLEXCEPT(Product, Product[Category]))) ORDER BY Product[Category], Product[Color]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), REMOVEFILTERS(Product))) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), FILTER(Product, Product[ListPrice] > 1000)))
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), FILTER(ALL(Product[ListPrice]), Product[ListPrice] > 1000))) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "v", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Product), FILTER(Sales, TRUE()))) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Sales), Sales[Quantity] > 3))
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Sales), Sales[Quantity] > 2 && Sales[UnitPrice] > 500))
EVALUATE ROW("v", SUMX(Sales, Sales[Quantity] * RELATED(Product[ListPrice])))
EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(Product, "p", Product[Product], "n", COUNTROWS(RELATEDTABLE(Sales))) ORDER BY [p]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year], "ship", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), USERELATIONSHIP(Sales[ShipDate], 'Date'[Date]))) ORDER BY 'Date'[Year]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Customer[Country], "v", CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Product), CROSSFILTER(Sales[ProductKey], Product[ProductKey], BOTH))) ORDER BY Customer[Country]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "promos", COUNTROWS(Promotion)) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "promos", COUNTROWS(VALUES(Promotion))) ORDER BY Product[Category]

EVALUATE ROW("values", COUNTROWS(VALUES(Customer)), "all", COUNTROWS(ALL(Customer)), "allnb", COUNTROWS(ALLNOBLANKROW(Customer)), "distinct", COUNTROWS(DISTINCT(Customer[CustomerKey])), "table", COUNTROWS(Customer))
EVALUATE ROW("values", COUNTROWS(VALUES(Product)), "table", COUNTROWS(Product), "valcol", COUNTROWS(VALUES(Product[Color])))
EVALUATE ROW("values", COUNTROWS(VALUES(Promotion)), "table", COUNTROWS(Promotion))
EVALUATE ROW("values", COUNTROWS(VALUES('Date')), "table", COUNTROWS('Date'))
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Customer[Customer], "qty", SUM(Sales[Quantity])) ORDER BY Customer[Customer]
EVALUATE ROW("v", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]), ISBLANK(Customer[Customer])))
EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(Product, "qty", CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity]))) ORDER BY Product[ProductKey]
EVALUATE ROW("v", SUMX(Product, CALCULATE(SUM(Sales[Quantity])) * 2))
EVALUATE SELECTCOLUMNS(FILTER(Product, COUNTROWS(FILTER(Product, EARLIER(Product[ListPrice]) > Product[ListPrice])) < 2), "p", Product[Product]) ORDER BY [p]
EVALUATE ROW("v", VAR x = SUM(Sales[Quantity]) RETURN x * 2 + x)
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "v", SELECTEDVALUE(Product[Category], "many"), "all", SELECTEDVALUE(Product[Color], "many")) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE ROW("v", HASONEVALUE(Product[Category]), "f", CALCULATE(HASONEVALUE(Product[Category]), Product[Category] = "Bikes"))
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Product[Category], "f", ISFILTERED(Product[Category]), "c", ISCROSSFILTERED(Sales[Quantity])) ORDER BY Product[Category]
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year], "v", CALCULATE(SUM(Budget[BudgetAmount]), TREATAS(VALUES('Date'[Year]), Budget[Year]))) ORDER BY 'Date'[Year]
EVALUATE ROW("a", 7 / 2, "b", 2 ^ 10, "c", -2 ^ 2, "d", 5 - BLANK(), "e", BLANK() - 5, "f", BLANK() * 5, "g", BLANK() + BLANK(), "h", 1 / 0)
EVALUATE ROW("int", 2 + 3, "mixed", 2 + 3.5, "div", 6 / 3, "cur", CURRENCY(1.5) * 2, "curdiv", CURRENCY(10) / 4, "curcur", CURRENCY(10) / CURRENCY(4), "pow", 2 ^ 3)
EVALUATE ROW("a", TRUE() || BLANK(), "b", FALSE() || BLANK(), "c", TRUE() && BLANK(), "d", BLANK() || BLANK(), "e", BLANK() && BLANK(), "f", NOT BLANK())
EVALUATE ROW("a", BLANK() = 0, "b", BLANK() = "", "c", BLANK() == 0, "d", BLANK() == BLANK(), "e", BLANK() < 1, "f", 0 IN {BLANK()}, "g", BLANK() IN {0})
EVALUATE ROW("v", COUNTROWS(FILTER(ALL(Product), Product[Color] = "RED")), "w", DISTINCTCOUNT(Product[Color]))
